summary: I'm a .NET Backend Developer based in Pune, Maharashtra, with {years} years of experience building web applications and RESTful APIs using C#, ASP.NET Core MVC and ASP.NET Core Web API.

My work spans a multi-tenant SaaS platform for US law firms and contractors, a healthcare management system and the corporate and product website of Panasonic Life Solutions India. I own backend features end to end — data modelling with Entity Framework Core on SQL Server and MySQL, JWT authentication with role-based access control and tenant isolation, Stripe payment integrations, and reporting APIs with Excel and PDF exports.

After a Bachelor of Engineering in Mechanical Engineering, I moved into software through CDAC's Post Graduate Diploma in Advanced Computing. More recently I've been building AI-assisted features, including conversational case management and an OCR + LLM document-extraction pipeline delivered through a Python FastAPI microservice.

projects.name: PerfectLien / AnyLien
projects.summary: Multi-tenant SaaS platform that helps US law firms and contractors manage construction lien cases, statutory deadlines, billing and notices.
projects.overview: PerfectLien / AnyLien is a lien case management platform for US law firms and contractors. I work on the ASP.NET Core Web API backend that powers multi-tenant case management, role-based workflows, payments, reporting and AI-assisted features.
projects.problem: Construction lien work is deadline-driven and document-heavy. Firms have to track contractor hierarchies, unpaid work months and statutory deadlines across many clients, while keeping every tenant's data strictly isolated.
projects.solution: A multi-tenant RESTful backend with JWT-based, tenant-scoped authorization; configurable lien stages with statutory deadline calculations; Stripe-powered billing; filterable reporting with Excel and PDF exports; and AI-assisted data entry through conversational inputs and OCR + LLM document extraction.
responsibilities: Developed RESTful APIs with ASP.NET Core Web API for the multi-tenant platform.
Implemented JWT authentication, role-based access control and tenant isolation across Super Admin, Law Firm Admin, Client and Employee roles.
Built lien case workflows: contractor-hierarchy parties, unpaid work months, configurable stages and statutory deadline calculations.
Integrated Stripe Checkout and credit-based controls for notice sending.
Built paginated, filterable reporting APIs with Excel and PDF exports.
Maintained the database schema through 230+ migrations with soft deletes and GUID-based keys.
